title: Finite-presentation representative isomorphic to the rank-match immersion
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-picard-universal-rank-match-locus-lfp, there exist a scheme W', a morphism j' : W' → S, and an isomorphism e : W ≅ W' such that j' is locally of finite presentation and e.hom ≫ j' = j.

source.place: rank decomposition, finite-presentation loci, and uniqueness/gluing of the representing immersion

proof.text: Apply the construction theorem to f and E, obtaining a locally finitely presented representing immersion j′. The characteristic property of j and j′, applied to their own maps to S, produces a : W → W′ and b : W′ → W with a ≫ j′ = j and b ≫ j = j′. Both immersions are monomorphisms. Cancelling j and j′ proves a ≫ b = identity and b ≫ a = identity. Package a and b into the required isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0BDP construction and uniqueness of representatives; explicit monomorphism cancellation in Lean by H1
